# PH-Composer API reference

Generated from the registered declarations. Do not edit by hand: `make fixtures` rewrites
this page, and the offline suite fails when it is stale. [API_QUICKSTART.md](API_QUICKSTART.md)
walks through one session from discovery to a verified edit.

Every name below is what `PhComposer::API.describe(name:)` answers for. Params and results are
JSON Schema; a number's `x-unit` is the SI unit it is stored and exchanged in. Every call except
`discover`, `describe` and `connect` answers with one outcome shape:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `completed`, `refused`, `failed`, `busy`, `pending` or `cancelled` |
| `code` | `ok`, or why the request did not complete, such as `revision.stale` or `target.changed` |
| `effect` | What happened to the Model: `none`, `committed`, `rolled_back` or `unknown` |
| `revision` | The Model revision after the call; send it back as `expected_revision` |
| `value` | The operation's result, described below as its result schema; absent unless completed |
| `affected` | Each record an action changed: `kind`, `id`, `change` and, for entities, `reference` |
| `findings` | Advisory rows the operation reports without refusing |
| `detail` | Structured data a caller needs to act on a refusal |
| `proposal_digest` | From a preview; send it with the invoke to refuse if the change is no longer the same |

A refused or failed action leaves the Model unchanged unless `effect` says otherwise. An action
whose value would change nothing completes with `effect` `none` and no Undo step.

## Record kinds

A catalog kind is stored in the Model's own records and read through `ph_composer.records.list`. An entity kind is stored on SketchUp geometry and read through its owner's queries; its writes are its owner's actions.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assembly`

Assembly, a catalog kind owned by `ph_composer.assemblies`, schema version 1.

References: `layers[].segments[].material_id` names one `ph_composer.assemblies.material`.

Values:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "name",
    "orientation",
    "layers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "datasheet_links": {
      "type": "array",
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.floor_segment`

Floor Segment, a entity kind owned by `ph_composer.spaces`, schema version 1.

Values:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "display_name",
    "weighting_factor",
    "net_area_factor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "weighting_factor": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1,
      "description": "The share of the area that counts toward the weighted floor area (iCFA, or TFA)."
    },
    "net_area_factor": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1,
      "description": "The share of the area that counts toward net volume."
    }
  }
}
```

Occurrence reference:

```json

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [

    "entity_path"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string"
    },
    "entity_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      ]
    },
    "boundary_condition": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "Outdoors",
        "Ground",
        "Adiabatic",
        "Surface",
        "AttachedZone"
      ]
    },
    "attached_zone_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Id of an Attached zone record; only with AttachedZone."
    },
    "assembly_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Id of the Face's Assembly."
    },
    "assembly_reversed": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True on the counterpart side of a Surface pair: the pair's Assembly seen from the other Zone, layers reversed. Only with Surface and an assembly_id."
    },
    "adjacency": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The Surface pair envelope Solve adjacencies writes; only with Surface."
    }
  }
}
```

## Library kinds

What `ph_composer.library.copy` can copy, by the wire kind its `kind` param names. Its `assignment` param takes the kind's assignment target, and the copy and the assignment are one Undo step.

## Common refusals

Every operation answers the codes of its kind's set besides its own, and an operation that needs the user to choose a location also answers the `approval` set. Each operation below lists only its own codes. `PhComposer::API.discover` returns these sets as `common_refusals`, and `describe` returns an operation's own codes as `refuses` and the sets it answers as `common_refusal_sets`. Every refusal has `code`, `owner` and `description`; the foundation's description is null. Discovery's `refusal_documentation` points to [Outcomes and codes](https://github.com/ph-composer/ph-composer-skp/blob/main/context/CONTRACTS.md#outcomes-and-codes).

| Set | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `action` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `request.pending`, `request.sequence_conflict`, `request.outcome_unavailable`, `revision.stale`, `proposal.changed`, `operation.rollback_unverified` |
| `view_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `setup_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `file_export` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `participant` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `operation.proposal_required`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `proposal.contribution_replaced` |
| `approval` | `access.user_required`, `request.cancelled` |
| `location` | `location.unknown`, `location.revoked`, `location.used`, `location.kind_mismatch`, `location.unavailable`, `location.setup_unreadable`, `location.setup_unavailable` |

What each common code means, as the agent connection's discover section `refusals` gives it:

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `access.user_required` | The operation needs a location only the user can choose; ask the user to approve one. |
| `location.kind_mismatch` | That approved location is for another kind of file or folder. |
| `location.revoked` | The user revoked that approved location. |
| `location.setup_unavailable` | This machine's location setup could not be read or saved. |
| `location.setup_unreadable` | This machine's stored location setup cannot be read. |
| `location.unavailable` | That approved location is no longer there as approved. |
| `location.unknown` | No approved location has that id. |
| `location.used` | That single-use location already added its library. |
| `operation.failed` | An unexpected error; the outcome's effect says whether anything was kept. |
| `operation.participant_cycle` | A participant was asked to call itself, directly or through another. |
| `operation.proposal_required` | A participant was called outside an action's proposal. |
| `operation.rollback_unverified` | An abort ran but the unchanged-data check failed or could not run. |
| `params.invalid` | The params do not meet the operation's params schema or a rule it states. |
| `proposal.changed` | The change is no longer the one the preview's proposal_digest described. |
| `proposal.contribution_replaced` | A contributor removed or changed what an earlier one proposed. |
| `proposal.foreign_write` | A participant or library callback staged a write to a kind its owner does not own. |
| `request.api_version` | The request names an API major version this build does not serve. |
| `request.cancelled` | The user dismissed the dialog that would have approved the request. |
| `request.capability_denied` | The caller's grant does not include the capability the operation needs. |
| `request.malformed` | The request envelope or its arguments are not well formed; nothing ran. |
| `request.outcome_unavailable` | The outcome is too old to know; read the Model before acting again. |
| `request.pending` | A retry of a request that is still running; ask for its outcome later. |
| `request.sequence_conflict` | This sequence or key was already used for a different change. |
| `revision.stale` | The Model changed after expected_revision; read again and decide again. |
| `session.busy` | Another change is running or deferred work is settling; read context and retry later. |
| `session.unknown` | The Model session is closed, was reopened or was never opened; discover again. |

## Queries

Called with a context granted `read`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

```json
  ],
  "properties": {
    "assembly_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^asm_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Assembly to read."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."

}
```

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.list`

```json
      "description": "The Assembly to read."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^lyr_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",

}
```

### `ph_composer.assemblies.materials.uses.list`

```json
      "description": "The Material to read."

      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."

}
```

### `ph_composer.context.children`

One bounded page of the native entities directly inside the Model root or one Group or component, by persistent id, each with its kind, name, whether it is hidden, locked, shared or a closed solid, and the PH-Composer records on it. Nothing is filtered out except by kinds. Reads only; nothing is selected. Owner: `ph_composer.context`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of the Groups and components from the root to the container, outermost first; [] or absent for the Model root."
    },
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "group",
          "component",
          "face",
          "edge",
          "other"
        ]
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Only children of these kinds; every kind when absent."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.context.read`

```json
  "type": "object",

      "type": "integer",

      "maximum": 200,
      "description": "Selected entities per page, 1 to 200; 100 when absent. A page also stops before its rows pass 16384 bytes."
```

### `ph_composer.records.detail`

One value of one stored record, exactly, as canonical JSON text in fragments: join every fragment's text in order, check its sha256 and parse it. Pass next_cursor back for the next fragment. Owner: `ph_composer.records`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind",
    "id",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Record kind id, as listed by discovery."
    },
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The record's id."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the record as ph_composer.records.list answers it, starting at values, user_data, extension_data, extension_status: [\"user_data\", \"notes\"], [\"values\", \"layers\", 0]."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind",
    "id",
    "type",
    "fragment",
    "next_cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "object",
        "array",
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The JSON type of the value at path; a stored null or false is a value."
    },
    "fragment": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "encoding",
        "offset",
        "bytes",
        "total_bytes",
        "sha256",
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "encoding": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "json"
          ],
          "description": "The fragments joined in order are the value's canonical JSON text."
        },
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Where this fragment starts, in UTF-8 bytes of the whole text."
        },
        "bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "This fragment's length in UTF-8 bytes."
        },
        "total_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The whole text's UTF-8 length."
        },
        "sha256": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "SHA-256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes, hex."
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "This fragment: whole characters, never a split one."
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "kind": "example.foundation.part",
  "id": "prt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "path": [
    "user_data"
  ]
}
```

```json
        "summary"
      ],
      "description": "full (the default): user_data, extension_data and extension_status as stored. summary: none of them, but their sizes, digests and status counts in metadata and each value's size in value_bytes; read any of them whole with ph_composer.records.detail."

      "type": "number",

}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list`

One page of the Faces of one Space or one Volume that carry no record yet: Floor candidates inside a Volume (for floors.mark) and loose Faces at the Space's root (for volumes.create); or the Faces loose in one context (for create), with no Space yet and no selection. Each has the refusal its operation would give it named alone now. Name exactly one of space, volume and context. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "space": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "space_id",
        "entity_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "space_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
        }
      },
      "description": "The Space whose children to read, by the reference a read returned."
    },
    "volume": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "volume_id",
        "entity_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "volume_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "minItems": 1,
          "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
        }
      },
      "description": "The Volume whose children to read, by the reference a read returned."
    },
    "context": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "A root-to-container path, [] for the root: its loose Faces, for a first Space."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "plan_area_m2",
          "normal",
          "horizontal",
          "loops_m"
        ]
      },
      "description": "What each row carries beside its id and reference. Absent, every field but the metadata (user_data, extension_data, extension_status) and loops_m."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.findings.list`

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.elements.list`

One bounded page of a Window Type's elements in stored order, each with its thermal result, installation edges and copy slot, beside the Type's totals and findings. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Window Type to read."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.list`

A bounded page of types with display findings. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids; every record when absent."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "values",
          "user_data",
          "extension_data",
          "extension_status",
          "findings",
          "display"
        ]
      },
      "description": "What each row carries beside kind, id and schema_version; the whole row when absent. Ask for fewer when a row is larger than your reply."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.restore_candidates`

A row with needs null supplies units.restore's params, which still checks the panes' exact geometry and may refuse. Needs no selection. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

```json
}
```

```json
            "description": "The refusal a write through this path meets from the path alone (a shared, nested or locked Zone, locked or shared storage), or null. A duplicated Zone id needs a walk; the write still resolves strictly."

        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.remove`

Remove one Layer. An Assembly keeps at least one Layer. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

Undo step: Remove Assembly Layer. Removes the Layer and its Layer-Segments; clears the air barrier if it was on that Layer.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.reorder`

Move one Layer to a position in the stored order, keeping the other Layers' relative order. Its current position changes nothing. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.set_material`

### `ph_composer.library.copy`

Copy or reuse one library record with optional assignment. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Undo step: Copy Library Record. Copies or replaces local definitions and optional assignments in one Undo step.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the row was read from, as catalog and in_file answer it. Required; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side. describe the library kind (discover's library_kinds names it) for that shape and its examples."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.create`

Make one new Space from a floor surface: explicit Faces loose in the open edit context, each becoming a Floor Segment. Faces joined by a shared Edge, a step included, share one Volume; Faces meeting only at a corner, or not at all, make separate Volumes. Works at the root, in a plain Group and in an open Zone, whose Space Group is placed outside the Zone at the same world position. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Undo step: Create Space. Groups each set of joined Faces as a Volume, the Volumes as the Space, and writes the Space, Volume and Floor Segment records.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `space.context_required`, `space.nothing_to_create`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "faces"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "faces": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "minItems": 1,
        "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Root-to-Face persistent-id paths."
    },
    "zone": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "zone_id",
        "zone_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "zone_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "zone_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "The Zone that hosts the new Space; absent or null for no Zone. ph_composer.spaces.create_preview names the one the review preselects."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The new Space's name; empty when absent."
    },
    "number": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The new Space's number; the next free one in its Zone, or among Spaces in no Zone, when absent."
    },
    "weighting_factor": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1,
      "description": "The weighting factor to write, 0 to 1; 1 counts the whole area."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "space_id",
    "volumes",
    "accepted",
    "left_out"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "space_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "volumes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "volume_id",
          "floor_segment_ids",
          "faces"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "volume_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "floor_segment_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "faces": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "minItems": 1,
              "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
            },
            "description": "The named Faces' root-to-Face paths before grouping, in floor_segment_ids order."
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each new Volume and its Floor Segments, one per set of Faces joined by shared Edges, numbered in that order."
    },
    "accepted": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "minItems": 1,

      },
      "description": "The named Faces taken, as create_preview accepts them."

    "left_out": {

          },

}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.update_metadata`

```json
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
              }
            },
            "description": "The occurrence to update, as a read returns it."
          },
          "user_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "Replaces the whole user_data map."
          },
          "extension_payloads": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "object"
            },

            "required": [

              "extension_data"

            "properties": {
              "user_data": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "extension_data": {
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.assign`

Assign one Thermal Bridge Type and quantity to explicit Edges, or reassign them; a stale or unwritable target refuses the whole command. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Undo step: Assign Thermal Bridge. Writes one assignment record on each Edge.

Before calling: Each Edge is inside a Zone, reached through no shared, locked or other Zone storage. Each target carries the reference and values edges.selection last read.

Refuses: `gesture.too_large`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets",
    "thermal_bridge_type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "zone_id",
              "zone_path",
              "entity_path",
              "entity_id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "zone_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "zone_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1
              },
              "entity_id": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "description": "The Edge's assignment id, or null for an Edge with none."
              }
            }
          },

            "type": "object",

    "quantity": {
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.clear`

Remove the thermal bridge assignment from explicit Edges. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Undo step: Clear Thermal Bridge. Removes the assignment record from each Edge.

Before calling: Each Edge is inside a Zone, reached through no shared, locked or other Zone storage. Each target carries the reference and values edges.selection last read.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `gesture.too_large`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "zone_id",
              "zone_path",
              "entity_path",
              "entity_id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "zone_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "zone_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1
              },
              "entity_id": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "description": "The Edge's assignment id, or null for an Edge with none."
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "The Edge's assignment values as last read; {} or absent for an Edge with none. A changed value refuses as target.changed."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Explicit Edge occurrences, as edges.selection returns them; at most 250."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "cleared"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cleared": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Edges whose assignment was removed."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json

    {

        "zone_path": [
          1201
        ],
        "entity_path": [
          1205
        ],
        "entity_id": "tbe_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.create`

Create one Window Type with one glazed element, 1.0 m wide by 1.5 m high unless values give columns_m and rows_m. The size does not follow the display unit system. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Create Window Type. Creates one Model-owned definition. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.locked`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.delete`

Delete Window Type; live references require replacement. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Delete Window Type. Rewrites referring definitions and defaults, then deletes atomically. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.duplicate`

Duplicate a Window Type with independent identity. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Duplicate Window Type. Copies definition metadata and retains shared products; new elements get fresh ids. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Window Type to copy."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name; \"<name> (copy)\" when absent. Names are unique."
    },
    "copy_datasheets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Keep the datasheet links on the copy; false when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "id": "wnt_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.insert`

Insert a row or column band at a grid boundary, filled with new glazed elements. Elements spanning that boundary must be split first. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Insert Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.kind`

Make elements glazed or Empty. Empty is wall area: it clears the elements' Glazing, Frames, installs and operation. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Change Window Element Kind. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.merge`

Merge two or more elements of one kind that cover one rectangle into a single element under a new id. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Merge Window Elements. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.paste`

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.remove`

Remove one row or column band and the elements only it held. Refused while the layout carries installation assignments, and for the last band. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Remove Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_frame`

Set or clear the Frame on one side of one glazed element; the other sides stay. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Frame. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_glazing`

Set or clear one glazed element's Glazing. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Glazing. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_operation`

Set or clear how one glazed element opens. A fixed element has no directions. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Operation. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.installs.save`

Assign Psi-Install Types to the edges of Window Type elements, in one Undo step, with any Psi-Install Types they need created, edited or copied from a library. Each listed element's four sides are replaced as given; null clears a side. A side may name a temporary client_id from psi_install_types.create or imports instead of a saved id. The panel's Installs session and the library assignment both use it; for one edge, list one Type with one element. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Installations. Creates or edits installation products and updates type edges atomically. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Calls: `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.update`

Edit guarded authored values of one Window Type. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Type. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.units.convert`

Replace reviewed drawn rectangles with placed Windows, one per group: a new Window Type sized from the geometry or a Type of that size. Sizes are the frame outer size. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Convert to Window Type. Erases the rectangles and the Edges only they use, healing the host Face, writes the new Window Types, and places one Unit per group, in one Undo step. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.convert_on_boundary`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_ambiguous`, `window.mull_not_rectangular`, `window.not_aligned`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "groups"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "sources"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "sources": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "required": [
                "path",
                "digest"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "path": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "minItems": 1,
                  "items": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  }
                },
                "digest": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The Face's geometry digest from the review."
                }
              }
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "maxItems": 500
          },
          "type_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
            "description": "A Window Type of this size; a new one when absent."
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The new Type's name. Default: its size in display units, with \" (2)\" added when taken."
          },
          "copy_from_type_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
            "description": "Copies this Type's first glazed element's glazing, frames and operation into every element of the new Type, and its installs onto the sides on the Type's perimeter. Default: blank elements."
```

```json
          "type_id": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    },

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Zone occurrences whose shared Faces to pair; Faces shared with a Zone outside the scope are left alone."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
}
```

### `ph_composer.context.open`

Open the Group or Component at the end of path as the edit context, through every one above it. Refuses a locked or missing step. Owner: `ph_composer.context`.

Side effects: Moves the edit path, which advances the Model revision. Leaving a Volume that was open and unprotected protects it again (Spaces locks it). No authored value changes; SketchUp itself records leaving a Group as an Undo entry, and undoing it reopens the Group.

Refuses: `session.inactive`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, and the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of Groups and Components from the root, outermost first."
    },
    "expected_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "The edit path as last read; refused when it has changed since."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
```

### `ph_composer.context.root`

### `ph_composer.view.capture`

Write a PNG of the current view at the current camera and answer its path, hash and what it shows. Geometry only. Owner: `ph_composer.view`.

Side effects: Writes one image file to a temporary folder; deletes this session's captures older than 15 minutes or beyond the newest four. Nothing in the Model or the view changes.

Needs the `capture` grant rather than `view`.

Refuses: `capture.failed`, `capture.too_large`, `capture.view_changed`, and the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,
      "description": "Pixels; give width and height together, or neither for the viewport's size."
    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,
      "description": "Pixels; give width and height together, or neither for the viewport's size."
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "sha256",
    "bytes",
    "width",
    "height",
```

### `ph_composer.zones.faces.locate`

Bring an explicit set of Faces into view and outline them, leaving the selection alone. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Side effects: Moves the camera to frame the Faces and outlines them until the selection changes. The edit path, the selection and the revision are unchanged.

Refuses: only the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "faces"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "faces": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "zone_id",
          "zone_path",
          "entity_path",
          "entity_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "zone_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "zone_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_id": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Face occurrences to bring into view and outline."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "found",
    "missing"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "found": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "How many references still resolved."
    },
    "missing": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "How many did not, and were skipped."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "faces": [
    {
      "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
      "zone_path": [
        1201
      ],
      "entity_path": [
        1202
      ],
      "entity_id": null
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,

      "minLength": 1,
```

### `ph_composer.library.connections.connect`

Start signing in to a hosted library. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `library.lifecycle_unavailable`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_unavailable`, and the `setup_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_kind"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The hosted library's provider kind, as ph_composer.library.connections lists it."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_kind",
    "label",
    "state",
    "lifecycle"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_kind": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "disconnected",
        "authorizing",
        "connected",
        "reauthorization_required",
        "unavailable"
      ]
    },
    "pairing_display": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z0-9]{2,8}(-[A-Z0-9]{2,8}){0,3}$",
      "description": "While authorizing: the code the sign-in page also shows, to match the two."
    },
    "lifecycle": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "connect",
          "disconnect",
          "reauthorize",
          "settings"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "provider_kind": "example.library.hosted"
}
```

### `ph_composer.library.providers.add_file`

Add a library file the user chooses in a native picker to this machine's libraries. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a file first. Any other caller passes `location`, the id of a location the user approved, or is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `library.file_malformed`, `library.file_too_large`, `library.file_unreadable`, `library.format_invalid`, `library.schema_unsupported`, `library.setup_too_large`, `library.setup_unavailable`, `library.setup_unreadable`, and the `setup_command` and `approval` and `location` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "array",
  "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": [
      "id",
      "label",
      "provider_kind"
    ],
    "properties": {
      "id": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "label": {
        "type": "string"
      },
```

## File exports

Called with a context granted `export`.

### `ph_composer.library.export_file`

Write local definitions to a library file the user chooses in the native save dialog; export_preview shows what it will hold. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a destination file first. Any other caller passes `location`, the id of a location the user approved, or is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `export.replace_required`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.catalog_too_many_rows`, `library.destination_changed`, `library.destination_invalid`, `library.export_write_failed`, `library.file_malformed`, `library.file_too_large`, `library.format_invalid`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.schema_unsupported`, `library.update_destination_invalid`, `library.update_destination_required`, `record.unreadable`, `revision.stale`, `target.not_found`, and the `file_export` and `approval` and `location` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "selected"
      ],
      "description": "all, the default, takes every supported local definition; selected takes only records."
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new",
        "update"
      ],
      "description": "new, the default, gives the file a new library id; update keeps the id of the library file being replaced."
    },
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Limit the export to these library kinds, such as materials."
    },
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "With scope selected: the records to export, each by record kind and id."
    },
    "library_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library name written into the file. Defaults to Model library, or to the replaced file's name for update."
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The Model revision export_preview reported; refused if the Model changed since."
    },
    "projection_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The projection_digest export_preview reported; refused if what would be written differs. Required to replace a file at an approved location."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kinds",
    "omissions",
    "library_id",
    "library_name",
    "identity",
    "written"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "record_kind_label",
          "count"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "record_kind_label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "The registered record kind's label, for display; kind and record_kind stay the identifiers."
          },
          "count": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "omissions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "record_kind_label",
          "fields",
          "reason"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "record_kind_label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "The registered record kind's label, for display; kind and record_kind stay the identifiers."
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          },
          "reason": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "library_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new",
        "update"
      ]
    },
    "written": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

## Proposal participants

Called by no client. An action of a feature that requires the owner names the participant in its `participants` and calls it inside its own proposal; its refusals are included in that action's.

### `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`

Copy or reuse one library record, with optional assignment, inside the calling action's own proposal and Undo step. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `participant` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the row was read from, as catalog and in_file answer it. Required; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side. describe the library kind (discover's library_kinds names it) for that shape and its examples."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "resolution",
    "local_id",
    "assigned"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "resolution": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "outcome",
        "candidates"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "outcome": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "create",
            "reuse",
            "review_required",
            "ambiguous_source",
            "ambiguous_name"
          ]
        },
        "candidates": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "id",
              "display_label",
              "differences",
              "expected_values",
              "comparison_available",
              "source_changed"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "display_label": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "description": "The local record's label; null when it has none."
              },
              "differences": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "required": [
                    "field",
                    "local",
                    "incoming",
                    "local_present",
                    "incoming_present"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "field": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "local": {
                      "type": [
                        "string",
                        "number",
                        "boolean",
                        "object",
                        "array",
                        "null"
                      ]
                    },
                    "incoming": {
                      "type": [
                        "string",
                        "number",
                        "boolean",
                        "object",
                        "array",
                        "null"
                      ]
                    },
                    "local_present": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "incoming_present": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "expected_values": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "comparison_available": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "source_changed": {
                "type": [
                  "boolean",
                  "null"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "assigned": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "provider_id": "example",
  "kind": "example_parts",
  "generation": 1,
  "library_id": "synthetic",
  "record_id": "one",
  "choice": "create"
}
```

## Export tasks

HBJSON runtime exports use retained task methods. Each params key is the method's keyword argument.

### `PhComposer::API.export_preflight`

Every export contributor's findings and the repairs it offers, before starting. Needs `read`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "An approved destination's id, to report what it holds now."
    }
  }
}
```

Result value:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "findings",
    "repairs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "findings": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "code",
          "section",
          "object_id",
          "message",
          "blocks_export"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "code": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "section": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "object_id": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "The record the finding is about."
          },
          "message": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "blocks_export": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "locate": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "name",
              "params"
            ],
            "description": "A view command that shows what the finding is about.",
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "params": {
                "type": "object"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "repairs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "id",
          "label",
          "checked",
          "action",
          "params"
        ],
        "description": "An action the export workflow offers to run before exporting.",

      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "exists",
        "state",
        "problem"
      ],
      "description": "With location: whether the pair exists and its state, and problem, why start_export refuses the destination itself (a name without .hbjson, or half of a prior pair), null when it does not. An existing pair is still replaced only with replace and this state as the location's expected_destination.",
      "properties": {

            "string",

          ]

          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      }

  }
}
```

### `PhComposer::API.start_export`

Start one export of the canonical HBJSON and its report to a destination the user approved (ph_composer.locations.approve_destination). An existing pair is replaced only with replace and the expected_destination export_preflight reported; one task runs per Model at a time. Needs `export`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "location"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result value:

```json

  "additionalProperties": false,
```
