## Feature codes

The codes each feature raises under its own noun, as an outcome's `code` or a finding's. The foundation's and the shared nouns' codes are listed in context/CONTRACTS.md, "Outcomes and codes".

### `ph_composer.agent_access`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `agent_access.connection_unavailable` | The token could not be saved for the client in its owner-only file. |
| `agent_access.limit` | This machine already has the most live agent tokens it keeps; revoke one first. |
| `agent_access.model_changed` | The open Model changed since the form showed it; nothing was issued. |
| `agent_access.model_unsaved` | A token can be bound only to a Model that has been saved to a file. |
| `agent_access.not_listening` | PH-Composer is not listening, so no client was set up. |
| `agent_access.store_unavailable` | The agent tokens could not be read or saved on this machine. |
| `agent_access.store_unreadable` | The stored agent tokens cannot be read; reset them before issuing another. |
| `agent_access.token_unknown` | No agent token has that id on this machine. |

### `ph_composer.assemblies`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `assembly.calculation_limit` | The exact thermal calculation exceeds its path budget; no value is given. |
| `assembly.geometry_invalid` | A Layer thickness, Layer-Segment width or steel-stud spacing is not positive. |
| `assembly.invalid` | The Assembly record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `assembly.material_dangling` | A Layer-Segment names a Material that is not in the Model. |
| `assembly.membrane_in_mixed_layer` | A Layer holding a membrane has more than one Layer-Segment. |
| `assembly.no_thermal_layers` | Every Layer is a membrane, so no U-value can be calculated. |
| `assembly.segment_unassigned` | A Layer-Segment has no Material. |
| `assembly.thermal_layer_limit` | The Assembly has more thermal Layers than a Honeybee OpaqueConstruction holds. |
| `material.conductivity_missing` | A non-membrane Material has no conductivity. |
| `material.invalid` | The Material record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `material.specific_heat_too_low` | A Material's specific heat is below the Honeybee minimum. |
| `material.thermal_mass_defaulted` | A Material has no density or specific heat; export uses disclosed defaults. |

### `ph_composer.spaces`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `space.context_required` | The edit context holding the Faces must be open to group them. |
| `space.duplicate_identity` | Another occurrence carries this Space, Volume or Floor Segment's id: a copy. |
| `space.empty` | A Space has no Volume. |
| `space.floor_disconnected` | A Volume's Floor Segments are not all joined by shared Edges; it still exports as drawn. |
| `space.floor_overlap` | Two Floor Segments of one Volume overlap in plan, so their shared area counts twice. |
| `space.floor_projected` | A Floor Segment is not horizontal; its plan area is used. |
| `space.height_missing` | A Volume has no average clear ceiling height. |
| `space.identity_unique` | The occurrence already has an identity of its own; there is nothing to repair. |
| `space.nested` | A Space is inside another Space. |
| `space.net_area_zero` | A Volume has no net floor area, so no height can be derived from a solid. |
| `space.nothing_to_create` | None of the Faces given can become a Space. |
| `space.number_duplicate` | Two Spaces in one Zone share a number. |
| `space.offset_from_zone` | A Space's Floor Segments lie outside its Zone's extents; it exports as drawn. |
| `space.outside_zone` | A Space is hosted in no Zone. |
| `space.position_unknown` | The Volume has no stored position to restore. |
| `space.same_zone` | The Space is already in that Zone. |
| `space.segment_misplaced` | A Floor Segment record is on a Face that is not directly inside a Volume. |
| `space.shares_edge` | A Face shares an Edge with a Face outside the set being grouped. |
| `space.solid_invalid` | The chosen Group or component is not a closed solid, or encloses no volume. |
| `space.volume_empty` | A Volume has no Floor Segment. |
| `space.volume_moved` | A Volume moved inside its Space since it was last left. |
| `space.volume_nested` | A Volume is below another Group inside its Space rather than directly in it. |
| `space.volume_open` | The Volume is open for editing; close it first. |
| `space.volume_orphan` | A Volume record is on a Group outside every Space. |
| `space.volume_protected` | The Volume is protected; unprotect it before opening it. |
| `space.volume_unprotected` | A closed Volume is unlocked, so its Faces can be edited from the Space. |
| `space.zone_missing` | A Space names a Zone that is no longer in the Model. |

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `thermal_bridge.coincident_conflict` | An assigned Edge coincides with one in another Zone that differs in Thermal Bridge Type, quantity or Building-Segment, so both are counted until one is cleared. |
| `thermal_bridge.hidden` | An Edge to locate, or a Group holding it, is hidden or on a hidden tag. |
| `thermal_bridge.interior_junction` | An assigned Edge lies only between interior Faces (Surface or To neighbour). |
| `thermal_bridge.no_envelope_face` | An assigned Edge bounds no classified envelope Face; it is likely a stray line. |
| `thermal_bridge.on_window_perimeter` | An assigned Edge lies on a placed Window's outline; its install psi-value belongs to the Window Type. |
| `thermal_bridge.outside_zone` | An assigned Edge is in no Zone, so it is not exported. |
| `thermal_bridge.psi_missing` | A Thermal Bridge Type has no psi-value, so an Edge using it cannot export. |
| `thermal_bridge.shared_definition` | An assigned Edge is in shared component storage and counts once per placement. |
| `thermal_bridge.type_missing` | Assigned Edges name a Thermal Bridge Type that no longer exists, so they cannot export. |

### `ph_composer.view`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `capture.failed` | SketchUp did not write the image. |
| `capture.too_large` | The image is larger than a capture may be; ask for fewer pixels. |
| `capture.view_changed` | The view changed while the image was written; capture again. |

### `ph_composer.windows`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `window.convert_on_boundary` | The drawn rectangle touches its host Face's edge; draw it inset and move the Window after converting. |
| `window.copy_id_pending` | A native copy shares this Window's identity until it is repaired. |
| `window.definition_changed` | The Window's geometry differs from its Type; reset it first. |
| `window.definition_detached` | The Window does not use its Type's primary definition. |
| `window.definition_editing` | The Window definition is open for editing; close it first. |
| `window.definition_missing` | The Type's primary definition no longer matches the Type. |
| `window.edited_geometry_replaced` | The Type edit replaces edited primary Window geometry. |
| `window.geometry_differs` | The Window's generated geometry or cutting behaviour differs from its Type. |
| `window.host_ambiguous` | The drawn rectangle lies on more than one coplanar Zone Face. |
| `window.host_boundary_unsupported` | The host Face's boundary condition is not Outdoors. |
| `window.host_required` | The action needs the matching host Face for this Window. |
| `window.host_type_unsupported` | The host Face is neither a Wall nor a Roof/Ceiling. |
| `window.host_unclassified` | The host Face has no Face type or owning Zone. |
| `window.host_zone_unresolved` | The host Face is not in one unambiguous authored Zone. |
| `window.mirrored` | The Window is mirrored; make a new flipped Type. |
| `window.mull_not_rectangular` | Rectangles sharing Edges do not tile one rectangle exactly. |
| `window.nested_units` | A Window is nested inside another Window. |
| `window.no_host_face` | No Face of a Zone beside the Window has room for it. |
| `window.not_aligned` | The drawn rectangle's sides are not parallel to its host Face's up and right. |
| `window.not_component` | A Window record is not on a native ComponentInstance. |
| `window.not_mirrored` | The chosen Window is not mirrored. |
| `window.not_rectangle` | The Face is not a rectangle with four square corners and no hole. |
| `window.off_host` | The Window does not lie in its host Face's plane. |
| `window.opening_area_exceeds_host` | The Windows on a Face cover more than its gross area. |
| `window.outlines_required` | The action needs every Window outline keyed by occurrence path. |
| `window.overhang` | The Window extends past its host Face or into one of its holes. |
| `window.overlap` | The Window overlaps another Window on the same host. |
| `window.rehost_parent` | A re-host Face must be in the Window's existing parent storage. |
| `window.restore_unavailable` | The stamped panes do not uniquely match the Type's outline. |
| `window.scaled` | The Window has native in-plane scaling. |
| `window.shared_definition_reset` | Reset replaces an edited primary definition for all of its Windows. |
| `window.sheared` | The Window has native in-plane shear. |
| `window.surface_host` | A paired Surface Face cannot host a Window. |
| `window.type_geometry_unknown` | A neighbouring Window's untouched geometry cannot be recovered. |
| `window.unhosted` | The Window is not glued to a resolvable host Face. |
| `window.unknown_type` | The Window names a Window Type that is not in the Model. |
| `window_type.construction_unavailable` | An element's Uw is outside what the pinned Honeybee simple glazing material accepts. |
| `window_type.construction_unresolved` | An element is missing a Glazing Ug, Frame Uf or Frame psi-g value. |
| `window_type.default_install_dangling` | The Model default Psi-Install Type is not in the Model. |
| `window_type.dimensions_incomplete` | A row or column dimension is missing or not positive. |
| `window_type.frame_operation_mismatch` | A Frame's operation differs from its element's operation. |
| `window_type.frame_width_unresolved` | An element's Frame width is missing. |
| `window_type.g_value_missing` | An element's Glazing has no g-value. |
| `window_type.geometry_unavailable` | The Type's opening area cannot be calculated. |
| `window_type.glazing_area_nonpositive` | An element's Frame widths leave no glazing area. |
| `window_type.install_unresolved` | No Psi-Install Type resolves for an element side. |
| `window_type.no_glazed_elements` | Every element of the Type is empty. |
| `window_type.operation_incomplete` | An element has no operation or no opening direction. |
| `window_type.partial_shared_edge` | An element edge is only partly shared, which has no proved installation mapping. |
| `window_type.product_dangling` | An element names a Frame, Glazing or Psi-Install Type that is not in the Model. |

### `ph_composer.zones`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `adjacency.counterpart_omitted` | A Surface Face's counterpart is omitted from the export, so the pair is exported as omitted too. |
| `adjacency.glued_instances` | A Face carries glued Component instances and was not cut for adjacency. |
| `adjacency.invalid` | A Face's stored Surface adjacency cannot be read. |
| `adjacency.multiple_neighbours` | A Face meets more than one neighbouring Zone and was not cut. |
| `adjacency.not_surface` | The Face has no Surface pair to retire. |
| `adjacency.overlapping_zones` | Two Zones overlap, facing the same way, so no Surface pair was made. |
| `adjacency.sliver_skipped` | A shared region below the geometry tolerance was not cut. |
| `adjacency.stale` | A Surface pair's geometry changed since it was matched; the Face is omitted. |
| `adjacency.unresolved` | A Surface pair's counterpart cannot be found or does not point back. |
| `adjacency.unsupported_shape` | A shared region's shape cannot be cut exactly. |
| `assignment.pending` | An Attached zone assignment is still open; finish it first. |
| `attached_zone.absent` | An AttachedZone Face names no Attached zone. |
| `attached_zone.dangling` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone that is not in the Model. |
| `attached_zone.factor_below_phius_floor` | An Attached zone's factor is below the Phius floor and needs the Phius Temperature Reduction Factor evidence. |
| `attached_zone.invalid` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone record that cannot be read. |
| `attached_zone.unavailable` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone written by a newer schema or carrying extension data this installation does not understand. |
| `construction.dangling` | A Face names an Assembly that is not in the Model. |
| `construction.incomplete` | A Face names an Assembly that cannot export yet; the message gives the first of its export_blockers. |
| `construction.invalid` | A Face names an Assembly record that cannot be read. |
| `construction.missing` | An exported Face names no Assembly. An interior Face within one Building-Segment needs none. |
| `face.assembly_exterior_condition_mismatch` | The Face's boundary condition differs from its Assembly's exterior condition. |
| `face.assembly_pair_mismatch` | The two Faces of a Surface pair do not hold one Assembly, reversed on one side. |
| `face.assembly_type_mismatch` | The Face's type differs from its Assembly's type. |
| `face.boundary_unassigned` | A Face has no boundary condition and is omitted from the export. |
| `face.identity_unique` | The Face has no split copies sharing its identity to repair. |
| `face.invalid` | A Face's assignment record cannot be read. |
| `face.type_missing` | A Face has no Face type. |
| `face.unclassified` | A Zone has unclassified Faces. |
| `face.wrong_zone` | A Face is contained by more than one Zone. |
| `gesture.retirement_conflict` | One gesture would retire the same Face's pair two different ways. |
| `gesture.too_large` | The gesture selects more Faces than one edit may change. |
| `zone.component` | A Zone record sits on a component, as Make Component leaves it, so it is not read as a Zone; Undo, or explode the component and restore the Zone. |
| `zone.identity_in_use` | The Zone being restored is already in the Model. |
| `zone.identity_unique` | The Zone's identity is already unique; there is nothing to repair. |
| `zone.none` | The Model has no Zone to export. |
| `zone.option_duplicate` | An equivalent managed option name already exists. |
| `zone.option_export_conflict` | Distinct Building Segments share one export identifier; map to a survivor. |
| `zone.options_adoption_required` | Adopt the legacy or copied choices before editing categories. |
| `zone.options_conflict` | Recovery or shared-storage choice evidence conflicts; explicit repair is required. |
| `zone.ownership_conflict` | A Zone record sits on, or inside, a Group another feature owns; deleting or removing that Group through its feature is refused while it is there. |
| `zone.restore_is_limited` | Restore recovers the Zone id, Building-Segment and Level only. |
| `zone.restore_unsafe` | The Zone cannot be restored from what remains. |

## API changes

| Version | Date | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | 2026-10-18 | describe adds capability, preview_capability, a view command's side_effects, preconditions and a query's response and while_busy; discover adds schemas; ph_composer.context.read is new. |
| 1.2 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.list answers bounded summaries with fields, the Model's sums before any filter and the sums of the page's Zones and Building-Segments; spaces.volumes.list, spaces.floor_segments.list and spaces.findings.list are new, Floor Segment loops only when fields asks. |
| 1.3 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list is new; spaces.update and spaces.batch_update type values and expected_values by field, with units, and refuse unknown keys at the schema. |
| 1.4 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.open and ph_composer.context.root are new view commands; the Spaces context commands and both locate commands declare side_effects. |
| 1.5 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.read answers the camera; the view generation also advances when the camera changes. |
| 1.6 | 2026-10-18 | The Outcome schema gains an optional sequence, set only by the agent connection's invoke and outcome results. |
| 1.7 | 2026-10-18 | export_status and latest_export give the caller that started a task its written pair's paths, SHA-256 and sizes as outcome.value.artifacts. |
| 1.8 | 2026-10-18 | The capture capability and ph_composer.view.capture are new; describe names the grant a view command declares when it is not view. |
| 1.9 | 2026-10-21 | ph_composer.view.capture no longer answers window_state: every window state measured gives the current view. |
| 1.10 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges is new: the Thermal Bridge Type kind, types.list, types.all and its snapshot section, and types.create, types.update, types.duplicate and types.delete. |
| 1.11 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.zones.containment is new. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.assign, edges.clear, edges.selection (bounded), edges.selection_all and the edges.selected snapshot section are new, over the ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge reference target; types.delete takes replacement_id. |
| 1.12 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges.schedule.list (bounded) and schedule.all are new: thermal-bridge runs with lengths, heat loss, findings and totals. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.runs.locate is a new view command. ph_composer.zones.containment, and so ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.selection, answers each Zone's name. |
| 1.13 | 2026-10-26 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge_tool.choose and edge_tool.stop are new view commands, with edge_tool.state and the edge_tool snapshot section: the pointer route to edges.assign. |
| 1.14 | 2026-10-26 | ph_composer.windows.units.outlines (bounded) is new: each placed Window's world outline. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.export_preflight is new, with the ph_composer.thermal_bridges.export.thermal_bridges export section and the thermal_bridge.on_window_perimeter code. |
| 1.15 | 2026-10-26 | The definition lists (ph_composer.assemblies.materials.list and assemblies.list, the Window product and Type lists, ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.list) take fields, keeping kind, id and schema_version on every row, and cut each page by size as well as by limit. |
| 1.16 | 2026-11-07 | A Face record gains assembly_reversed, true on the counterpart side of a Surface pair. ph_composer.zones.faces.assign_assembly, and classify with an assembly_id intent, also write the counterpart (its face_ids include it). face.assembly_pair_mismatch now blocks export; construction.missing no longer applies to a Surface Face whose pair is within one Building-Segment. |
| 1.17 | 2026-11-08 | An unexpected failure's detail gains error_class beside incident. ph_composer.zones.solve_adjacency's result gains already_paired. An Assembly's Layer, Layer-Segment and air-barrier ids and its Material references state their pattern in every schema that names them. |
| 1.18 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.windows.units.return_to_host is new. It puts a Window that has left its Face back on the nearest Face of its Zone, and adds window.no_host_face. |
| 1.19 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.windows.settings gains default_psi_install_w_mk, 0.04 W/mK unless set: what an edge with no Psi-Install Type inherits when the Model has no default Type. |
| 1.20 | 2026-11-08 | The thermal-bridge schedule and export count one Type on Edges two Zones of one Building-Segment share once. thermal_bridge.coincident_conflict replaces thermal_bridge.counted_twice for coincident Edges that differ. |
| 1.21 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.spaces.all no longer answers a Zone's imbalanced or findings, and space.airflow_imbalance is gone: supply and extract balance per ventilator, not per Zone. |
| 1.22 | 2026-11-08 | A Frame gains brand, an optional text field, in ph_composer.windows.frames and the frames library kind. |
| 1.23 | 2026-11-08 | A Window Unit reads its native name in ph_composer.windows.units.list and .all; ph_composer.windows.units.rename and ph_composer.windows.units.selection are new. |
| 1.24 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.windows.units.convert_review is new: which drawn rectangles Convert to Window Type would take, as Type layouts, and why it leaves the others out. |
| 1.25 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.windows.units.convert is new: reviewed drawn rectangles become Window Types and placed Windows in one Undo step. |
| 1.26 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.windows.units.convert_review's groups gain default_name, and it leaves out rectangles overlapping across Groups as window.overlap; convert's groups take copy_from_type_id. ph_composer.windows.convert_dialog.open, close and state are new, with the convert_dialog snapshot section and the convert_menu menu item. |
| 1.27 | 2026-11-09 | A Space's Zone is the record's zone_id, a core reference; ph_composer.spaces.move_to_zone is a record edit and no longer refuses space.context_open. ph_composer.spaces.unhost and the space.zone_missing finding are new; ph_composer.zones.make_independent takes copy_added and ph_composer.zones.isolate_copied_group is new, for a plain Group copied whole. |
| 1.28 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.spaces.create and create_preview take faces as root-to-Face paths and work in any edit context; create takes an optional zone; create_preview answers zone and height_m, and left_out rows carry path. create_review.open takes faces and revision and the review carries zones and height_m. ph_composer.zones.stamp_container and the nested_container reason are gone; zones export rows lose container_paths. |
| 1.29 | 2026-11-09 | The ph_composer.spaces.labels readout is now ph_composer.spaces.show, on by default in every Model session; it draws each Volume's preview outline with the Space labels. |
| 1.30 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.spaces.remove is new: a Space's records go and its floor Faces stay as plain geometry, in one Undo step. |
| 1.31 | 2026-11-09 | A Volume whose Floor Segments overlap in plan reads the space.floor_overlap finding, a warning that does not block export. |
| 1.32 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.spaces.create and volumes.create make one Volume per set of Faces joined by shared Edges and answer volumes, a list of volume_id and floor_segment_ids, in place of volume_id and floor_segment_ids. A Volume whose Floor Segments are not all joined reads the space.floor_disconnected finding, a warning that does not block export. The add_volume_menu menu item is new, and create_menu is no longer offered inside a Space. |
| 1.33 | 2026-11-10 | ph_composer.spaces.volumes.delete is new: it erases one Volume and its floor Faces in one Undo step, where volumes.remove keeps the Faces. The delete_volume_menu menu item is new. |
| 1.34 | 2026-11-10 | ph_composer.spaces.create answers accepted and left_out as create_preview does, and each new Volume of create and volumes.create answers faces, its source Face paths. spaces.delete, remove, volumes.delete and volumes.remove refuse target.foreign_records while another feature's records are on or inside the Group. Make Zone refuses a Group holding a claimed object at any depth (target.wrong_hierarchy) and Restore a claimed member (target.wrong_kind); zones.list, zones.all and export preflight read the zone.ownership_conflict finding, which does not block export. A Face reference with a null entity_id refuses target.changed on every Face write once the Face has a record, and zones.update and update_metadata refuse a locked Zone (target.locked) as update_field does. |
| 1.35 | 2026-11-10 | discover adds library_kinds, and describe answers a library kind by name (its wire kind and version, and its assignment target schema and examples or that it has none) and an installed extension by namespace. The agent connection's discover takes section, owner, limit, cursor and topic for bounded pages of operations, record kinds, reference targets, extensions, library kinds, common refusals with their meanings, contracts and the operating guide; initialize names the guide. ph_composer.library.copy's generation says it is required, as its schema already did. |
| 1.36 | 2026-11-10 | Selection-free reads at an explicit path: ph_composer.context.children pages the entities directly in the root or one Group or component, with their state and records; zones.make_candidates, windows.units.convert_candidates and windows.units.restore_candidates list what Make Zone, Convert and Restore could take there; thermal_bridges.edges.at and edges.candidates read Edges by path in edges.selection's rows plus endpoints_m; and spaces.candidate_faces.list takes context for a first Space. A name over 256 characters is cut and named in the row's truncated. edges.selection's copied flag no longer refuses for an unreadable record on another Edge. |
| 1.37 | 2026-11-10 | Complete reads of large definitions and metadata: ph_composer.records.detail answers one value of a record exactly in fragments with its size and SHA-256; records.list pages by size and takes metadata summary; assemblies.assemblies.layers.list and segments.list, windows.types.elements.list, assemblies.materials.uses.list and windows.<collection>.uses.list page a definition's parts and derived results; and preview takes within and preview_part, so a preview larger than a reply keeps its proposal_digest and is read by part. |
